summary: A snowmobiler punched through a cornice atop Ptarmigan Hill at Vail Pass and broke a leg; Vail Mountain Rescue Group responded.
notes: Date approximate: April 2016; listed as first of month. VMRG volunteer essay 'Thoughts on Mountain Rescues from Beneath the Snow' (Feb-2017 issue, parent-opened) describes 'one mission last April'; no exact day found in targeted searches. Run-649 backfill (VMRG archives chunk).
